do.text: Give the table `getRowId`, so a selection or an edit follows its row through a sort, a filter or a page.

dont.text: Don't leave rows tracked by position: after a sort, the tick lands on whichever row moved there.

do.text: Show the few columns a reader compares; put the rest behind a row action or the columns menu.

dont.text: Don't show every field: the reader scrolls sideways and loses their row.
